asked.item: export gave slides.zip instead of MP4
how to get an MP4 instead of the ZIP

verdict.reason: The help pages give the exact steps to re-export as MP4 by turning off the Slideshow toggle, which answers the customer's question about getting an MP4 instead of the ZIP.

steps.text: A ZIP of slide images comes from exporting with the Slideshow toggle on, and an MP4 comes from exporting with it off.
Open the visual in the editor.
Click "Export" in the top right corner.
Click "Download" to save the MP4 file.
